name: Hong Dae
desc: Two Hongdae walks: the Gyeongui Line Forest Park (Yeontral Park → Book Street → Seogang sky bridge, green) and the Red Road busking street from Hongik Univ. Station down to the Han River (red). Lines from Naver Map's official courses.

line.name: Yeontral Park → Hongik Univ. Stn → Book Street → Seogang sky bridge, 2.7 km

segments.label: Official course line from Naver Map (마포걷고싶은길 1코스 · 경의선숲길), Gajwa → Seogang section

pins.name: Start – Gajwa Station, north end of Yeontral Park (가좌역)
pins.desc: Gyeongui–Jungang line. Exit 1 and walk south-east into the park; the first stretch runs beside the stream to Yeonnam-dong. If you prefer a shorter walk, start at Hongik Univ. Station exit 3 instead (1.3 km in).

pins.name: Yeontral Park – Yeonnam-dong section (연트럴파크 · 경의선숲길)
pins.desc: The lawn-and-stream stretch everyone picnics on; cafés and bakeries on both sides. Busiest at weekends and in the evening.

pins.name: Hongik University Station exit 3 (홍대입구역 3번출구)
pins.desc: Lines 2, Gyeongui–Jungang and AREX. The park passes under the big road here; cross with the lights and continue on the other side.

pins.name: Gyeongui Line Book Street (경의선책거리)
pins.desc: 250 m of book kiosks shaped like train carriages, benches and small publishers' stalls; most open from about 11:00, closed Mondays.

pins.name: Ddaengddaeng-geori crossing (홍대 땡땡거리)
pins.desc: Named after the old railway crossing bell; a short lane of bars and restaurants where the line used to cross Wausan-ro.

pins.name: Seogang Station (서강대역)
pins.desc: Gyeongui–Jungang line, right beside the park.

pins.name: End – Seogang sky bridge, start of the bridge (서강하늘다리 시작점)
pins.desc: The footbridge that carries the park over Seogang-ro next to Seogang Station. The park continues south-east to Gongdeok if you want another 1.5 km.

line.name: Red Road busking street: Hongik Univ. Stn exit 9 → Eoulmadang-ro → Red Road stage → Han River, 1.9 km

segments.label: Official course line from Naver Map (홍대 레드로드, main spine R1–R7)

pins.name: Start – Hongik University Station exit 9 (홍대입구역 9번출구)
pins.desc: Lines 2, Gyeongui–Jungang and AREX. Exit 9 opens straight onto the busking street; the crowds start here from late afternoon.

pins.name: Busking zone – Hongdae Walking Street (홍대 걷고싶은거리 · 레드로드 R1)
pins.desc: The main busking stretch along Eoulmadang-ro: dance crews and singers most evenings, biggest on Friday and Saturday nights. Street food and the Hongdae Playground on the right.

pins.name: Red Road stage & art centre (레드로드)
pins.desc: Mid-point of the Red Road, a 2023 pedestrian-first redesign of Hongdae's streets in red paving. Performance stages and the Red Road art lab are around here; Sangsu Station is 200 m east.

pins.name: Sangsu Station (상수역)
pins.desc: Line 6, a short detour east of the route. Cafés of Sangsu-dong are between here and the river.

pins.name: End – Mapo Saebit Culture Forest and the Han River (마포새빛문화숲)
pins.desc: The Red Road ends at the riverside park by the old Danginri power station, now a cultural park, with the Han River cycle path beyond. Hapjeong Station (lines 2 and 6) is 10 min north-west.
